school.school_name: 松江栄養調理製菓専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find a FY2026 target confirmation form from a small school page with plain year anchors.
search_queries: 松江栄養調理製菓専門学校 機関要件確認申請書
松江栄養調理製菓専門学校 令和8年度 機関要件
steps: Open the search result titled 高等教育の就学支援に関する機関要件確認申請書.
Use the dedicated school-support page instead of the generic school profile pages.
Choose the anchor labeled 令和８年度.
Accept it as FY2026 because the page label is 令和８年度 and the PDF body contains 様式第２号 with the school name.

reusable_rules: Search for the school name plus 機関要件確認申請書 when the top page does not expose 情報公開 in navigation.
Treat anchors labeled 令和８年度 as strong FY2026 evidence when the linked PDF body has 様式第２号 and the school name.
For small school pages, prefer a dedicated /school-support page over generic 学校案内 or 学校概要 pages.
anti_patterns: Do not require the PDF filename to contain 2026 when the page anchor supplies a reliable Reiwa-year label.
Do not reject a target form only because the first PDF page starts directly with 様式第２号 instead of a cover page.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-11 found the 令和８年度 anchor and verified the PDF body contains 松江栄養調理製菓専門学校 and 様式第２号.
